uncertain.text: Y, Υ, υ, ὖ ψιλόν, τό.
uncertain.note: The mark over the upsilon looks like a cup or breve and is unclear. I read it as smooth breathing plus circumflex (ὖ), as in the usual name of the letter. It could also be a bare circumflex (ῦ).

The headword Xylograph runs across the column gap: 'Xyl' sits at the right of strip 03 and 'ograph' starts strip 04. The print has no hyphen. I added 'Xyl-' and started strip 04 with '~ ograph' so that assembly joins them into 'Xylograph'.

uncertain.text: ~ träda in i y:en ... νέον εἶναι. / Yrka ... / Yrke, se Lefnadsyrke, -bana 2), Handt-
uncertain.note: Section order on this page is wrong. Strip 08 is two-column text: column 1 continues Ynglingålder (from 0524_06) and goes on to 0524_09; column 2 holds Yrka and Yrke and goes on to 0524_10 ('verk.'). Strip 09 ends '(προ-, ἐκ)-', and that word continues at the top of 0524_07 ('φαίνεσθαι'). The correct order is 06, 08-left, 09, 07, 08-right, 10. I wrote strip 08 with column 1 first and then column 2. In the kit's order, the '~' continuations will join to the wrong entries when assembled.
